workflow_states.meaning: Dimension routed to human lane by routing contract; packet not yet created.
Packet created; valid review not yet ingested. Criterion unadjudicated.
Submitted review failed schema/evidence validation. Criterion remains unadjudicated; no coercion.
Dual blind reviews disagree on >=1 intermediate field. Requires adjudication pass; no automatic final label.
Valid review or adjudication complete; final critical label derived mechanically via frozen derivation table.

transition_rules: REQUIRED -> PENDING on valid packet creation (mechanical packet validation 100%).
PENDING -> RESOLVED only on valid review ingest + mechanical derivation.
PENDING -> INVALID on schema-invalid or evidence-invalid review; INVALID stays unadjudicated (may receive a corrected review).
PENDING -> DISAGREEMENT on dual reviews differing in any intermediate field; DISAGREEMENT resolves only via adjudication record.
No transition from any non-terminal state to a final critical label without human intermediate labels.
No automated M2 verdict anywhere in the workflow.
